description: Applicant's age in whole years at application time. 20 to 94 after cleaning; the 5 raw rows above 100 (including ages 123 and 144) were removed as data-entry errors. The API accepts 18 to 100.
Applicant's annual income in the dataset's currency units (whole number, 4,000 to 2,039,784). Strongest single driver of predicted risk (mean |SHAP| 0.92).
Housing status: RENT, MORTGAGE, OWN or OTHER. Used as a category; renters default more often in this data.
Years in the current job, decimal, 0 to 41 after cleaning (2 raw rows above 60 removed). 887 rows are empty; the model fills them with the training median, so the column is nullable.
Purpose of the loan: EDUCATION, MEDICAL, VENTURE, PERSONAL, DEBTCONSOLIDATION or HOMEIMPROVEMENT. Raw default rate ranges from 14.8% (VENTURE) to 28.6% (DEBTCONSOLIDATION).
Lender's own risk grade from A (best) to G (worst). Raw default rate rises from 10.0% in grade A to 98.4% in grade G. Used as the baseline approval rule in the NPA back-test.
Loan amount requested, whole number, 500 to 35,000. Used as the weight in the NPA ratio by amount.
Annual interest rate offered, percent with 2 decimals, 5.42 to 23.22. 3,094 rows are empty (rate not priced yet); the model fills them with the training median, so the column is nullable.
Target label: 1 if the loan defaulted, 0 if it was repaid. 7,088 of the 32,409 cleaned rows are 1 (21.9%). This is what the model predicts as a probability of default (PD).
loan_amnt divided by person_income, 2 decimals, 0.00 to 0.83. Highest correlation with default (0.38). The scoring API computes it itself; clients never send it.
Y if the credit bureau file shows a past default, N if not.
Length of the applicant's credit history in whole years, 2 to 30.
